long_biography.plain_text:
Before founding Disetronic, Willy Michel trained as a federally qualified pharmaceutical consultant and spent six years leading Novo Nordisk's Swiss business. He brought development, sales and marketing experience to insulin delivery, helping create pump systems when patients still depended largely on syringes. The resulting business paired device engineering with practical self-care.

Michel stepped away from Ypsomed's board in 2022 and became honorary chairman without an executive or governing function. Three years later, his controlled company TecMed acquired Ypsomed's diabetes-care operation, separating insulin pumps from Ypsomed's self-injection systems. The transaction left two specialised medical-device companies under distinct structures while preserving his ownership interests in the sector.
long_biography.html:
Before founding Disetronic, Willy Michel trained as a federally qualified pharmaceutical consultant and spent six years leading Novo Nordisk's Swiss business. He brought development, sales and marketing experience to insulin delivery, helping create pump systems when patients still depended largely on syringes. The resulting business paired device engineering with practical self-care.

Michel stepped away from Ypsomed's board in 2022 and became honorary chairman without an executive or governing function. Three years later, his controlled company TecMed acquired Ypsomed's diabetes-care operation, separating insulin pumps from Ypsomed's self-injection systems. The transaction left two specialised medical-device companies under distinct structures while preserving his ownership interests in the sector.

The March 2026 Ypsomed disclosure reports a controlling Michel family shareholder group and identifies Michel's direct and indirect holdings, but does not allocate the full group stake to him personally. Separately, Ypsomed identifies TecMed, subsequently mylife Group, as controlled by Michel.

Roche's acquisition price, the later diabetes-care transaction price, Ypsomed's market value, factory investments and company assets are corporate measures. None is presented as Michel's personal net worth or solely owned property.
